name: U.S. Packaging & Wrapping LLC.
old_description: At US Packaging and Wrapping, we understand that effective packaging is crucial to your operation's success. Since our founding, we've been dedicated to providing high-quality industrial packaging materials and equipment that protect your products and streamline your processes. Whether you're a small business or a large manufacturing facility, our extensive selection ensures you'll find exactly what you need.
about:
U.S. Packaging & Wrapping LLC operates from Austin, Arkansas. The company was founded to supply industrial packaging materials and equipment, though the exact year and founders are not publicly disclosed.

The firm distributes a broad range of packaging consumables including PVC and polyolefin shrink films, biodegradable shrink options, polyethylene tubing, hand and machine stretch films, conductive and static-shielding bags, and vacuum packaging bags. It also supplies packaging machinery such as automatic shrink bundlers, L-bar sealers, side-sealing shrink wrappers, shrink tunnels, stretch wrap machines, vacuum sealers, strapping equipment, and case sealers. Beyond product sales, the company offers contract packaging services, an interactive equipment demo room, product testing for customers, parts and service support, and net-30 credit terms.

Customers range from small businesses to large manufacturing facilities across food packaging, electronics, and general industrial sectors. The company highlights its ability to serve operations requiring static protection for sensitive electronics and flammable products, as well as food-grade packaging applications.

The company emphasizes decades of packaging experience, honest recommendations, and competitive pricing as differentiators. It promotes an interactive demo room where customers can test equipment, a product-testing service for specific applications, and a selection of American-made products.
